## 2. Actual source boundary and red/fixed evidence

The integer predictor receives only model/baseline request and integrity context,
never expected answers, oracle objects, case labels as dispatch keys or evaluation r.
It contains no original endpoint constants: it performs inversion, latent intersection,
projection and decoder intersection. The supervisor alone reads the manifest/oracle
for comparisons; capacity probes receive their declared component dimension, not a
prediction. Hashes check integrity, not choose answers. Ordinary evaluations carry
actual prior prediction bytes and must preserve the frozen complete request hash.
F9–F11 instead visibly carry predeclared hostile artifacts.

The Fraction checker imports neither predictor nor oracle; it independently
reconstructs ready carriage and computes raw J/witnesses. Common shares admission,
hashing/serialization only, not predictive equations. Two worker roots contain only
six runtime sources; package/oracle/manifest/inventory remain outside. The open audit
hook checks full resolved paths against runtime root/Python base prefix, logs basename
and allowance, and denied the outside package canary in every retained run. This is
audited code/data separation, not a hostile-code OS sandbox or empirical independence.

## 3. Mathematical semantics and actual findings

Frozen laws: `b=x+beta+e_b`, `r=x+e_r`. x,b,r are absolute Celsius readings;
offset/errors are Celsius differences, gains dimensionless 1, reference bias 0.
Positive beta raises b and is subtracted when conditioning. x lies in real closed
[0,100]; nominal beta=(0,20), a_b=a_r=0.5. P2 supplies beta2=5; P3 supplies
a_b=a_r=10. Supports are complete assumed Cartesian sets, not probabilities,
statistical independence, empirical maxima or confidence intervals. No parameters
were fitted; citations/commitments establish provenance, not predictive accuracy.

Actual predictor: `I_b=[b-beta-a_b,b-beta+a_b]`, `X=[0,100]∩I_b`, and, for nonempty
X=[L,U], `R=[L-a_r,U+a_r]`. Missing support is unknown, not narrow fallback; empty X
is baseline incompatibility with null future cells, not a manufactured excluded row.
Checker: `J=[0,100]∩I_b∩[r-a_r,r+a_r]`. Nonempty J is compatible with lower-endpoint
witness x and errors b-x-beta,r-x checked in both domains. Empty J is conditionally
excluded. Neither nominated H fitting means model mismatch, not identified cause.
Unknown/out-of-scope/unassessable cannot become that supported elimination claim.

Predictor uses exact scale-10^6 integers; checker uses Fraction. Independent Decimal
endpoint/witness constraints, importing neither runtime nor oracle math, checked the
**actual** records: 1,507 audit assertions on 94 roles/200 objects passed. A separately
written semantic checker passed all 76 non-resource roles, checking raw record/trace
equality, unknown no-elimination and J/dispositions. Decimal precision 28 suffices
for bounded six-place addition/subtraction; no float epsilon, sampling or quantization
of the real feasible domains is used. Shared assumptions are expressly disclosed.

open singleton intersections are empty. Negative/above-100 readings are admitted,
not clamped. Clipping means latent intersection before projection: neither instrument
saturation nor decoder clipping. At baseline 40 raw discrimination persists; only
the coarse decoder loses it. At nominal 50 coarse low permits H2 while raw J rejects
both; no finite candidate/decoder obligation forces a winner.

## 5. Dynamic tests and smallest falsifiable checks

Fixed cases dynamically establish changed-baseline/offset/uncertainty recomputation,
raw/category separation, missing support no-elimination, widened both-fit, narrow
neither-fit, endpoints and both clipping boundaries. S7–S11 retain unit/subject/
episode/edition/acquisition controls; S3–S6/S13–S14 distinguish unknown and false
applicability. F4 rejects negative width; P2 checks positive-offset subtraction.
F6–F8 reject unsupported gain/bias/joint substitutions. F9/F10 test external pins;
F11 tests independently pinned false arithmetic, demonstrating hash integrity is
not mathematical integrity.

Six bounded worker invocations over approved input copies/twins cover mandatory
invariance/substitution obligations: base P0; coherent subject rename; an unused
synthetic declaration; exact Qb sign-law substitution; P4 before/after deleting its
unused nominal declaration. Rename/unused record preserve numerical semantics while
retaining changed correct request/model hashes. The unused record is not a new law.
P4 stays unknown whether that spare value exists or not. Qb replaced by
`b = x - beta + e_b` refuses `model_unsupported @ /model/equations` with zero
predictor calls; no alternate law runs. All six stay within the full profile: maxima
input 5,020 bytes/198 nodes/depth 7; output 3,247 bytes/202 nodes/depth 8.

Seven deliberately bad **verification-output** controls are independently rejected:
hard-coded original ranges at P1; unsupported P4 cell/raw exclusions; forced unique
survivor at P3; coarse-decoder forced winner at nominal 50; residual-only acceptance
beyond lower/upper clipping. Complete mutants/rejections are retained. These test
verifier falsifiability, not new scientific cases or changed oracle semantics. Together
with actual F11 refusal and neither-fit cases, they can detect a mathematically bad
model/implementation consequence instead of merely confirming same-model pairs.
They cannot validate physical robustness or empirical accuracy.
